title: Rent Delinquency Prediction

blueprintSignals.name: Payment timing drift
blueprintSignals.definition: change in days between the due date and payment over the last 4 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Autopay hides it, so analyse autopay tenants through a different signal

blueprintSignals.name: Portal activity
blueprintSignals.definition: visits to the payment page without a payment in the 10 days before the due date
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Noisy, and depends on how often tenants log in

blueprintSignals.name: Rent burden change
blueprintSignals.definition: percentage rent increase minus any change in verified income
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Income data are often missing, so mark unknown explicitly

blueprintSignals.name: Maintenance disputes
blueprintSignals.definition: count of open maintenance complaints older than 14 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Logging is inconsistent, so use only closed-loop ticket data

label: For "Rent Delinquency Prediction": Predict which tenants will miss rent in the next month so property managers can reach out early with payment plans. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Outreach changes outcomes, so a tenant helped by a plan looks like a false alarm.
